newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee closes up in kerb, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee closes up in kerb, seen rising.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.30 up in the kerb market at 40.20 to the dollar on Tuesday after its devaluation by the central bank diminished demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open higher on Thursday after a public holiday on Wednesday, one dealer said.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan adjusted the rupee down at 36.9700/37.1549 to the dollar on Tuesday from 35.6200/35.7981 fixed on August 29. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 9.30 percent after opening at 10.00 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
